aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source rows but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is overbroad and mixes class labels with totals as conditions.
Baseline/test meaning of Normal versus Yoke classes is not fully established.
Measurement outcomes are auto-stat aggregates from headers, not valid row-level results.
Subgroup key Class 1 is incorrect because all yoke classes are compared.
Function rows appear duplicated or split without preserved date/round context.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as yoke class sorting/check condition versus Normal only if supported by rows.
Preserve date, line/jig, test round, class, and function type as grouping keys.
Replace aggregate measurement stats with actual input/OK rate/function NG result rows.
Separate totals from conditions and avoid treating headers as measurements.
Remove or explain duplicate Normal/function blocks before approval.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited evidence is not sufficient until data rows and grouping context are corrected.
